audit.whatIsWrong: Labelled HARD 8/10 with the full layer giving Vex all seven level rows, while the packet chart and the content layer both give Akali all seven and the win rate is 48.54% over 2367 games.
audit.why: Two of the three sources say Akali holds the lane phase; only the full layer disagrees, and 48.54% is a near-even result, not an 8/10 counter. Vex's real claim on the matchup is a specific one — Doom 'n Gloom interrupts dashes — which makes the lane awkward rather than lost.
audit.corrected: TRICKY, 6.5/10, carry threat 7/10, with all seven full-layer rows flipped to Akali to match the packet and the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes were built around a nonexistent execute and a nonexistent dash cooldown.
audit.why: Vex has no mobility whatsoever until Shadow Surge at level 6 — Mistral Bolt is a 1200-range missile and Looming Darkness is a slowing zone. Her defensive spike is Personal Space, a 16-second shield that lands exactly on top of Akali's burst window (the missing-interactions rule flags it). Her level 6 is a mark-and-dash missile, not a threshold ult.
audit.corrected: 3-5 spike is 'she cannot leave'; the recurring obstacle is the 16s shield; 6 is Shadow Surge's missile.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/E/W/R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Five separate fabrications: an ability called 'Doom Bringer' (used seven times), 'Mistral Bolt's dash', 'her only mobility, a short cooldown E', Personal Space described as a 'fear-radius zone', and an 'execute threshold' on her ultimate.
audit.why: Her ultimate is Shadow Surge — 'Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage' — with no execute in the text. Mistral Bolt is 'a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight', not a dash. Looming Darkness is a slowing Gloom zone, not mobility. Personal Space is 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies' — the FEAR belongs to Doom 'n Gloom, her passive, which empowers her next basic ability to fear AND INTERRUPT DASHES, and which marks any nearby enemy who dashes to shorten its own cooldown. That passive is the entire matchup for Akali: her E recast and both casts of Perfect Execution are dashes, and every one of them both risks the interrupt and speeds the fear back up.
audit.corrected: Enter on foot while the glow is up, force Personal Space's 16s shield out before committing burst, and keep the E recast and R for after the empowered ability is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns stated, and the advice to 'commit on Personal Space's cooldown' was aimed at the wrong spell.
audit.why: Personal Space is 16/15/14/13/12 (the shield), Looming Darkness is a flat 12, Mistral Bolt is 8 falling to 4, and Shadow Surge is 140 at rank 1. Doom 'n Gloom has no fixed timer at all — it is periodic and accelerated by your own dashes, which is why counting it is the wrong instinct and not dashing is the right one.
audit.corrected: Shield 16s, ult 140s, and the fear is on a timer you control by not dashing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Mistral Bolt's' in wants.foe[2]; the larger error it did not catch is 'Doom Bringer', which is not an ability in this game.
audit.why: Suspect-name matching found the near-miss but not the wholly invented name. 'Your Perfect Execution' is a false positive — Akali's own R.
audit.corrected: All seven 'Doom Bringer' uses replaced with Shadow Surge or removed.

notes: The worst matchup in this slice for fabricated content. 'Doom Bringer' is not an ability in League of Legends and appeared seven times as Vex's ultimate — the real R is Shadow Surge, a marking missile with a recast dash, and it has no execute threshold. Also removed: 'Mistral Bolt's dash' (it is a missile), 'her only mobility is a short cooldown E' (Looming Darkness is a slowing zone; Vex has NO mobility before level 6), and Personal Space described as a fear radius (it is a shield plus nearby damage). The fear belongs to Doom 'n Gloom, the passive, which additionally INTERRUPTS DASHES and has its cooldown shortened by every nearby enemy dash — against a champion whose E recast and both R casts are dashes, that is the defining interaction of the matchup and it was never written down. Also added the flagged shield-absorbs-burst point. Full-layer chart gave Vex all seven rows against the packet and content layer both giving Akali all seven; flipped the full layer as one atomic group and brought HARD 8/10 down to TRICKY 6.5/10 to match a 48.54% win rate. focus.text is 25 characters before and 24 after, right at the applier's skip threshold — it may be dropped harmlessly. phases[N].rating left untouched for the same scale ambiguity noted on veigar.
